name: use-permissions
title: usePermissions, usePermission
description: usePermissions and usePermission: the permissions block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the permissions block (`npx better-supabase add permissions`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/repository/permissions.
